subject.title: [Feature]: Allow pinning plugin tabs in the Control UI sidebar

question: Should plugin-contributed Control UI tabs become a durable, user-pinnable sidebar preference type alongside built-in routes and sessions?
rationale: This is a new core preference and navigation capability rather than a repair to an established plugin-tab contract; maintainers must choose the long-term ownership and compatibility boundary.

options.title: Approve a stable plugin-tab entry
options.body: Add a serialized plugin-tab sidebar entry with explicit unavailable-plugin and identifier-stability behavior, then implement focused UI coverage.

options.title: Keep plugin tabs in More
options.body: Retain the current plugin-tab navigation boundary and close the request as a declined product direction.

options.title: Prefer a plugin-owned navigation seam
options.body: Define a narrower extensibility approach only if maintainers do not want core sidebar preferences to persist plugin-tab identities.

recommendation.title: Approve a stable plugin-tab entry
recommendation.body: Add a serialized plugin-tab sidebar entry with explicit unavailable-plugin and identifier-stability behavior, then implement focused UI coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Best available routing candidate for the Control UI navigation and product-boundary decision.
